Move to your last extra turn.

2511-5088-5148-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
2511-5088-5148-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2511-5088-5148-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping basic lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Early Harvest with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Early Harvest from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Early Harvest.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Corsair Captain.
Resolve both Corsair Captain triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.

Repeat.

112-3617-6496.manaNeeded: {7}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-3617-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-3617-6496.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Time Walk and exiling the original Time Walk with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Time Walk copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Time Walk and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Time Walk's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Time Walk and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Time Walk's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-3617-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Time Walk is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Time Walk is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.
